message.reasoning_content: We need to answer the question: "Regarding the Commonwealth Games, what do Canada and Wales have in common?" Use evidence. Evidence says Canada has participated in every Commonwealth Games since first in 1930, one of only six countries to have done so. The others are Australia, England, New Zealand, Scotland, and Wales. So Canada and Wales have both participated in every Commonwealth Games. So answer: They have both participated in every Commonwealth Games.
